title: NUTRITIONZ COMPAT
description: a data pack that adds compatibility between the nutritionZ mod and many other food related mods
body:
📖 **Overview**

This data pack adds full [NutritionZ](https://modrinth.com/mod/nutritionz) compatibility for dozens of food mods, giving every item proper values for carbohydrates, protein, fat, vitamins, and minerals.

Having issues with modded food not having values for nutritionz?, with this data pack every supported modded food now fits into the balanced diet system, keeping gameplay immersive and rewarding.

✨ **Features**

✅ Adds realistic [NutritionZ](https://modrinth.com/mod/nutritionz) values for hundreds of modded food items.\
✅ Ensures every supported food mod integrates seamlessly.\
✅ Balanced nutrition encourages diverse diets rather than spamming one food.\
✅ Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer servers.

ℹ️ **Important**

This data pack requires [NutritionZ](https://modrinth.com/mod/nutritionz) installed to function.

🛠️ **Installation**

Make sure [NutritionZ](https://modrinth.com/mod/nutritionz) is installed.\
Place the datapack in your world’s datapacks folder.\
Reload or restart the world.\
Enjoy balanced NutritionZ integration with all your modded foods.
